cards.ex: We're having a real Indian summer this year, it's lovely and warm in October.
cards.exUz: Bu yil bizda haqiqiy kuzgi oftob bo'lyapti, oktyabrda juda yoqimli va iliq.
cards.uzDef: Kuzda kutilmaganda iliq va quyoshli ob-havo bo'lishi.

cards.ex: The weather vane on top of the barn was spinning wildly in the gale.
cards.exUz: Omborxonaning tepasidagi shamoldirgich bo'ronda shiddat bilan aylanayotgan edi.

cards.ex: Hopefully, the sun will come out later this afternoon.
cards.exUz: Umid qilamanki, quyosh bugun tushdan keyinroq ko'rinadi.

cards.ex: The old house weathered the winter surprisingly well.
cards.exUz: Eski uy qishdan juda yaxshi o'tdi.

cards.ex: I'm really feeling the heat today; I need to drink more water.
cards.exUz: Men bugun issiqni juda his qilyapman; men ko'proq suv ichishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yuqori haroratni his qilish, ayniqsa issiq hududda.

cards.ex: We experienced a deluge of rain yesterday, flooding the streets.
cards.exUz: Kecha biz sel yomg'irni boshdan kechirdik, ko'chalar suv ostida qoldi.

cards.ex: There was a touch of frost on the ground this morning.
cards.exUz: Bugun ertalab yerda sovuq izi bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Yengil sovuq qoplami, ko'pincha erta tongda.

cards.ex: Many accidents on the roads are weather-related.
cards.exUz: Yo'llardagi ko'plab baxtsiz hodisalar ob-havo bilan bog'liq.

cards.ex: We'll be having the picnic rain or shine.
cards.exUz: Biz piknikni yomg'ir yoki quyoshda o'tkazamiz.

cards.ex: The sky started to cloud over just as we reached the beach.
cards.exUz: Biz plyajga yetib kelganimizda osmon bulut bilan qoplanishni boshladi.

cards.ex: A gentle breeze rustled the leaves in the trees.
cards.exUz: Yengil shabada daraxtlardagi barglarni shitirlatdi.

cards.ex: The weather conditions made driving very difficult.
cards.exUz: Ob-havo sharoitlari haydashni juda qiyinlashtirdi.
cards.uzDef: Ob-havoning holati, masalan, harorat, shamol, yomg'ir.

cards.ex: The constant rain is really taking its toll on the crops.
cards.exUz: Doimiy yomg'ir ekinlarga haqiqatan ham zarar yetkazmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ob-havo biror narsaga salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatishi.

cards.ex: Torrential rain caused widespread flooding in the city.
cards.exUz: Jala yomg'ir shaharda keng tarqalgan suv toshqiniga sabab bo'ldi.

cards.ex: There's a weather warning for heavy snow tomorrow.
cards.exUz: Ertaga qor yog'ishi bo'yicha ob-havo ogohlantiruvi bor.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli ob-havo sharoitlari haqida rasmiy ogohlantirish.

cards.ex: The region is suffering from a prolonged drought.
cards.exUz: Hudud uzoq davom etgan qurg'oqchilikdan aziyat chekmoqda.

cards.ex: The town was under a blanket of snow this morning.
cards.exUz: Bugun ertalab shahar qor adyoliga o'ralgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Qor, tuman va hokazo bilan qoplangan.

cards.ex: The air was thick with humidity before the storm.
cards.exUz: Bo'ron oldidan havo namlik bilan to'lgan edi.

cards.ex: A ray of sunshine peeked through the clouds.
cards.exUz: Bulutlar orasidan quyosh nuri mo'raladi.

cards.ex: We are expecting a fair weather this weekend.
cards.exUz: Biz bu hafta oxirida yaxshi ob-havo kutmoqdamiz.

cards.ex: It's chucking it down outside; I'm soaked!
cards.exUz: Tashqarida qattiq yomg'ir yog'yapti; men ivib ketdim!

cards.ex: Be careful you don't get heat stroke in this weather.
cards.exUz: Ehtiyot bo'ling, bu ob-havoda issiqlik urishi bo'lmasin.
cards.uzDef: Yuqori harorat tufayli tananing qizib ketishi.

cards.ex: We're hoping for clear skies tonight to see the stars.
cards.exUz: Biz bugun kechqurun yulduzlarni ko'rish uchun tiniq osmondan umid qilmoqdamiz.

cards.ex: High winds caused damage to buildings and trees.
cards.exUz: Kuchli shamollar binolar va daraxtlarga zarar yetkazdi.

cards.ex: We had a cold spell last week, with temperatures dropping below zero.
cards.exUz: O'tgan hafta sovuq havo bo'ldi, harorat nol darajadan pastga tushdi.

cards.ex: Did you check the weather forecast for tomorrow?
cards.exUz: Ertangi ob-havo bashoratini tekshirdingizmi?

cards.ex: After the announcement, we received a deluge of requests for information.
cards.exUz: E'londan so'ng, biz ma'lumot uchun talablar selini oldik.

cards.ex: The dust storm made it impossible to see more than a few feet.
cards.exUz: Chang bo'roni bir necha futdan ortiq ko'rishni imkonsiz qildi.
cards.uzDef: Chang va qum bilan to'lgan kuchli shamol.

cards.ex: The precipitation levels have been very low this year.
cards.exUz: Bu yil yog'in miqdori juda past bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lum bir hududda yog'ingarchilikning umumiy miqdori.

cards.ex: There's a foggy patch on the motorway, so drive carefully.
cards.exUz: Avtomagistralda tumanli joy bor, shuning uchun ehtiyotkorlik bilan haydang.
